# LossSpikePhenomenon

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Sudden, transient increases in training loss that occur when weight norms cross a critical threshold, often triggered by normalization-weight decay interactions. In TCC/iNEST, loss spikes can propagate through interconnected compute nodes, causing cascading failures in distributed neuromorphic systems.
